title: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xato
goal_uz: Dars oxirida o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashishuvchilarning eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xatosini tanib tuzatasiz: artikl, kelishuv, zamon, predlog, say/tell, soxta do‘stlar, ikkita inkor.

scenes.title: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xato
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda so‘zlashuv iboralarini o‘rgandik. Bugun o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilarning eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xatosini tuzalamiz: artikl, kelishuv, zamon, predlog, say va tell, soxta do‘stlar va ikkita inkor. Dars oxirida 8 ta xato gapni o‘zingiz tuzatasiz. Har bir xato — bir dars — men sizga birma-bir ko‘rsataman.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson 21. Today we fix the 30 most common mistakes Uzbek speakers make.
scenes.say_uz: 21-darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashishuvchilarning eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xatosini tuzalamiz.

scenes.title: Guruh 1: artikllar

examples.t: I saw a dog. The dog was black.
examples.uz: Men it ko‘rdim. It qora edi.

scenes.say_native: Artiklning bitta asosiy qoidasi: birinchi marta — a/an, ikkinchi marta — the. Misol: „I saw a dog. The dog was black“ — men it ko‘rdim. It qora edi — birinchi gapda — a, ikkinchi gapda — the. „I like dogs“ — umuman — artikllarsiz.Nemis tili emas, o‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q — shuning uchun eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — artiklni butunlay tashlab ketish. Nemis tili emas, lekin ingliz tilida artikllar majburiy — „a cat“, „the cat“. Nemis tili emas, lekin „I am a doctor“ — men shifokorman — a majburiy. Birinchi uch majburiy artikl xato: 1) „I am doctor“ — to‘g‘ri: a doctor; 2) „She is the teacher“ — to‘g‘ri: a teacher; 3) „The dogs are loyal“ — to‘g‘ri: Dogs are loyal — umum uchun artiklsiz. Nemis tili emas, lekin eslab qoling: birinchi marta — a/an, ma’lum — the, umum — hech narsa.
scenes.say: I saw a dog. The dog was black. I like dogs. I am a doctor. Dogs are loyal. The first time — a/an. The second time — the. In general — no article.
scenes.say_uz: Men it ko‘rdim. It qora edi. Menga itlar yoqadi. Men shifokorman. Itlar sodiq. Birinchi marta — a/an. Ikkinchi marta — the. Umuman olganda — artiklsiz.

scenes.title: Artikl mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta artikl gapini yozing. Birinchi: „I saw a dog“ — birinchi marta — a. Ikkinchi: „I saw the dog again“ — ikkinchi marta — the. Uchinchi: „Dogs are loyal“ — umum — artiklsiz. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I saw a dog. The dog was black. I saw the dog again. Dogs are loyal. A first, then the, then no article for generals.
scenes.say_uz: Men it ko‘rdim. It qora edi. Men yana itlarni ko‘rdim. Itlar sodiq. Birinchi a, keyin the, keyin umum uchun hech narsa.

scenes.title: Guruh 2: kelishuv — do/does

examples.t: He does his homework. (not he do)

scenes.say_native: Do va does — har doim shaxs bo‘yicha. „do“ — ko‘plik, I va siz uchun; „does“ — birlikdagi uchinchi shaxs uchun.Misol: „He does his homework“ — u uy vazifasini bajaradi — does + fe’l oddiy shakli. Nemis tili emas, lekin eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — „He do his homework“ — noto‘g‘ri. Nemis tili emas, lekin do / does — yordamchi fe‘l: „He doesn't do his homework“ — u uy vazifasini bajarmaydi — doesn't + do. Nemis tili emas, lekin „She does“ — u bajaradi; „They do“ — ular bajaradilar. Nemis tili emas, lekin „Do you like coffee?“ — siz kofeni yoqtirasizmi? Nemis tili emas, lekin „Does she like coffee?“ — u kofeni yoqtiradi? Nemis tili emas, lekin quyidagini yodda tuting: I do, you do, he/she does, we do, they do. Nemis tili emas, lekin does dan keyin s yo‘q — „He doesn't do“ to‘g‘ri, „He doesn't does“ xato.
scenes.say: He does his homework. He doesn't do his homework. Does she like coffee? Do you like coffee? I do, you do, he does, we do, they do. Does — then base form, never does does.
scenes.say_uz: U uy vazifasini bajaradi. U uy vazifasini bajarmaydi. U kofeni yoqtiradimi? Siz kofeni yoqtirasizmi? Men qilaman, sen qilasan, u qiladi, biz qilamiz, ular qiladilar. Does — undan keyin oddiy shakl, hech qachon does does emas.

scenes.title: Kelishuv mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta kelishuv gapi yozing. Birinchi: „He does his homework“. Ikkinchi: „She doesn't do her homework“ — doesn't + do. Uchinchi: „Does he like coffee?“ — savol. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: He does his homework. She doesn't do her homework. Does he like coffee? Do you know the answer? He does, she doesn't, they do.
scenes.say_uz: U uy vazifasini bajaradi. U uy vazifasini bajarmaydi. U kofeni yoqtiradimi? Siz javobni bilasizmi? U qiladi, u bajarmaydi, ular qiladilar.

scenes.title: Guruh 3: zamonlar va do‘stlari

examples.t: I really like this movie. (not I'm liking)

scenes.say_native: Zamonlarning uchta asosiy tuzog‘i. Birinchi — stative fe’llar: „like, know, want, understand, need“ — hozirgi oddiyda: „I like this movie“ — men bu filmni yoqtiraman — hozirgi oddiy, doimiy shakl. Nemis tili emas, lekin „I'm liking it“ — noto‘g‘ri — stative fe’llarda -ing yo‘q. Ikkinchi — hozirgi tugallangan: „I have finished“ — men tugatdim — have + past participle — „I finished“ — o‘tgan oddiy — boshqa ma‘no. Uchinchi — „did“ dan keyin oddiy shakl: „I didn't finish“ — men tugatmadim — did + base, „didn't finished“ xato. Nemis tili emas, lekin „I have went“ — noto‘g‘ri — „I have gone“ — to‘g‘ri. Uch qoida: stative uchun oddiy hozirgi; tugallangan uchun have/has; did dan keyin base form. Nemis tili emas, lekin mashq qiling — har kuni inglizcha gapiring.
scenes.say: I like this movie. I have finished. I have gone. I didn't finish — not didn't finished. Do you understand? I want to understand. Did you like it? Have you understood?
scenes.say_uz: Men bu filmni yoqtiraman. Men tugatdim. Men bordim. Men tugatmadim — tugatmadim emas. Tushunasizmi? Men tushunishni xohlayman. Yoqtirdingizmi? Tushundingizmi?

scenes.title: Zamonlar mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta to‘g‘ri gap tuzing. Birinchi: „I like this movie“ — stative fe’l. Ikkinchi: „I have finished the report“ — tugallangan. Uchinchi: „I didn't finish the report“ — did + base. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I like this movie. I have finished the report. I didn't finish the report. Did you like it? Have you understood?
scenes.say_uz: Men bu filmni yoqtiraman. Men hisobotni tugatdim. Men hisobotni tugatmadim. Yoqtirdingizmi? Tushundingizmi?

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 1: xatda beshta xato
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglang: xatdagi beshta xatoni toping. „Dear Sir, I am doctor — a yo‘q“ — a doctor. „I have went — have gone“ — have gone. „I can to help — can to emas“ — can help. „This is mine book — my book“ — my. „I am agree — I agree“ — am agree emas. Nemis tili emas, lekin bu xatlar eng ko‘p uchraydi. Savollar: beshtasini sanab bering.
scenes.say: Dear Sir. I am a doctor. I have gone to the conference. I can help you. This is my book. I agree with the proposal.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli janob. Men shifokorman. Men konferensiyaga bordim. Men sizga yordam berishim mumkin. Bu mening kitobim. Men taklifga roziman.

scenes.title: Xat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Xat bo‘yicha beshta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: „I am doctor“ — nima kerak — a doctor. Ikkinchi: „I have went“ — to‘g‘risi — have gone. Uchinchi: „I can to help“ — to‘g‘risi — can help. To‘rtinchi: „mine book“ — to‘g‘risi — my book. Beshinchi: „I am agree“ — to‘g‘risi — I agree. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What is missing in the first line? What is the correct form of have went? What is wrong with can to? What should replace mine? Is I am agree correct or not?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi qatorda nima yo‘q? Have went ning to‘g‘ri shakli nima? Can to ning nimasi noto‘g‘ri? Mine ning o‘rniga nima qo‘yilishi kerak? I am agree to‘g‘rimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: xat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. „I am a doctor“ — a majburiy. „I have gone to the conference“ — have gone — hozirgi tugallangan. „I can help you“ — can + base form — can to emas. „This is my book“ — my, mine emas. „I agree“ — am agree emas. Nemis tili emas, lekin bu besh xato — har kuni yozgan xatlarda uchraydi. Muntazam mashq qiling.
scenes.say: I am a doctor. I have gone to the conference. I can help you. This is my book. I agree with the proposal.
scenes.say_uz: Men shifokorman. Men konferensiyaga bordim. Men sizga yordam berishim mumkin. Bu mening kitobim. Men taklifga roziman.

scenes.title: Guruh 4: predloglar in/on/at

examples.t: Meet me at 5 pm on Monday in June.
examples.uz: Dushanba kuni soat 5 da iyunda uchrashaylik.

examples.t: I was born on the 3rd of May in 1995.

scenes.say_native: Predloglarning uchta asosiy qoidasi. „at“ — soat uchun — „meet me at 5 pm“ — soat beshda uchrashaylik. Nemis tili emas, lekin „on“ — kunlar va tarixlar uchun — „on Monday“ — dushanba kuni; „on the 3rd of May“ — 3-mayda.„in“ — oylar, yillar, kun qismlari uchun — „in June“ — iyunda; „in 1995“ — 1995-yilda; „in the morning“ — ertalab. Nemis tili emas, lekin quyidagini yodda tuting: soat — at, kun — on, oy va yil — in. Nemis tili emas, lekin eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — „in Monday“ — noto‘g‘ri — „on Monday“ to‘g‘ri. Nemis tili emas, lekin „at night“ — kechasi; „at home“ — uyda; „at work“ — ishda. Nemis tili emas, lekin „in the evening“ — kechqurun; „in winter“ — qishda.Nemis tili emas, lekin shablon: at — vaqt, on — kun, in — oy va yil. Nemis tili emas, lekin mashq qiling.
scenes.say: Meet me at 5 pm on Monday in June. I was born on the 3rd of May in 1995. At night, at home, at work. On Monday, on Tuesday, on the 5th of May. In the morning, in winter, in 1995.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba kuni soat beshda iyunda uchrashaylik. Men 1995-yilda 3-mayda tug‘ilganman. Kechasi, uyda, ishda. Dushanba, seshanba, 5-may. Ertalab, qishda, 1995-yilda.

scenes.title: Predloglar mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta predlog gapi yozing. Birinchi: „Meet me at 5 pm“ — at + soat. Ikkinchi: „Meet me on Monday“ — on + kun. Uchinchi: „Meet me in June“ — in + oy. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Meet me at 5 pm. Meet me on Monday. Meet me in June. At night, on Tuesday, in winter, in 1995, on the 3rd of May.
scenes.say_uz: Soat beshda uchrashaylik. Dushanba kuni uchrashaylik. Iyunda uchrashaylik. Kechasi, seshanba kuni, qishda, 1995-yilda, 3-may.

scenes.title: Soxta do‘stlar va say/tell

examples.t: I bought it in the shop.

scenes.say_native: Soxta do‘stlar va say/tell tizmi. „shop“ — ingliz tilida do‘kon — o‘zbekchada „magazyn“ emas.„sympathetic“ — rahmdil — „do‘stona“ emas — „friendly“ — do‘stona.„sensible“ — oqilona — „hisli“ emas — „sensitive“ — hisli.„say“ — eshittirish — „She said that…“ — u aytdiki… — „tell“ — aytish — „He told me that…“ — u menga aytdiki… — tell + kishi. Nemis tili emas, lekin eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: „She said me“ — noto‘g‘ri — „She told me“ yoki „She said to me“ to‘g‘ri. Nemis tili emas, lekin „explain“ dan keyin to merge bo‘ladi: „explain to me“ — menga tushuntir — „explain me“ emas. Nemis tili emas, lekin soxta do‘stlar ro‘yxatini yodda tuting. Nemis tili emas, lekin „Do you speak English?“ — ingliz tilida gaplashasizmi? Nemis tili emas, lekin „I speak English“ — men ingliz tilida gaplashaman.
scenes.say: I bought it in the shop. She is very sympathetic. He is sensible. She said that… He told me that… Explain to me, not explain me. Do you speak English? I speak English.
scenes.say_uz: Men buni do‘kondan sotib oldim. U juda rahmdil. U oqilona. U aytdiki… U menga aytdiki… Menga tushuntir, explain me emas. Siz ingliz tilida gaplashasizmi? Men ingliz tilida gaplashaman.

scenes.title: Soxta do‘stlar va say/tell mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta to‘g‘ri gap tuzing. Birinchi: „I bought it in the shop“ — do‘kon. Ikkinchi: „He told me that…“ — tell + kishi. Uchinchi: „Explain to me“ — to + kishi. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I bought it in the shop. He told me that he was late. Explain to me how this works. She said to me that she agreed. He is sensible.
scenes.say_uz: Men buni do‘kondan sotib oldim. U menga kech qolganini aytdi. Menga tushuntiring bu qanday ishlashini. U menga roziman deb aytdi. U oqilona.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 2: yig‘ilishda oltita xatoni toping
board: I have went to the meeting…
The meeting is on Monday in 5 pm…
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglang: yig‘ilishda oltita xatoni toping. „I have went — have gone“. „She don't — does not yoki doesn't“. „He is agree — I agree“. „Explain me — explain to me“. „on Monday in 5 pm — on Monday at 5 pm“. „I didn't finished — didn't finish“. Nemis tili emas, lekin bu oltita xato — har bir inglizcha yig‘ilishda uchraydi. Savollar: oltitasini sanab bering.
scenes.say: I have gone to the meeting. She doesn't like the plan. I agree. Explain it to me. The meeting is on Monday at 5 pm. I didn't finish the report.
scenes.say_uz: Men yig‘ilishga bordim. U rejani yoqtirmaydi. Men roziman. Menga tushuntiring. Yig‘ilish dushanba kuni soat beshda. Men hisobotni tugatmadim.

scenes.title: Yig‘ilish 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Yig‘ilish bo‘yicha oltita savolga javob bering. Birinchi: „I have went“ — to‘g‘risi — have gone. Ikkinchi: „She don't like“ — to‘g‘risi — doesn't like. Uchinchi: „He is agree“ — to‘g‘risi — I agree. To‘rtinchi: „Explain me“ — to‘g‘risi — explain to me. Beshinchi: „on Monday in 5 pm“ — to‘g‘risi — on Monday at 5 pm. Oltinchi: „I didn't finished“ — to‘g‘risi — didn't finish. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What is the correct form of have went? What about she don't? Is he is agree correct? What replaces explain me? What is the correct time preposition? What about I didn't finished?
scenes.say_uz: Have went ning to‘g‘ri shakli nima? She don't haqida nima? He is agree to‘g‘rimi? Explain me ning o‘rniga nima? To‘g‘ri vaqt predlogi nima? I didn't finished haqida nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar: yig‘ilish 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. „I have gone to the meeting“. „She doesn't like the plan“. „I agree with the proposal“. „Explain it to me“. „The meeting is on Monday at 5 pm“. „I didn't finish the report“.Nemis tili emas, lekin bu oltita xato — har kuni yig‘ilishlarda uchraydi. Muntazam mashq qiling — ingliz tilida gaplashishingiz professional.
scenes.say: I have gone to the meeting. She doesn't like the plan. I agree. Explain it to me. The meeting is on Monday at 5 pm. I didn't finish the report.
scenes.say_uz: Men yig‘ilishga bordim. U rejani yoqtirmaydi. Men roziman. Menga tushuntiring. Yig‘ilish dushanba kuni soat beshda. Men hisobotni tugatmadim.

scenes.title: Guruh 5: ikkita inkor va sanaladigan/sanalamaydigan
scenes.say_native: Ikkita inkor — eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolardan biri. „I don't have any money“ — menda pul umuman yo‘q — to‘g‘ri. Nemis tili emas, lekin „I don't have no money“ — noto‘g‘ri — ikkita inkor emas, bitta inkor yetadi — ingliz tilida.Nemis tili emas, lekin „not … any“ — har doim bir inkor — „I don't see any problems“ — men umuman muammo ko‘rmayman. Nemis tili emas, lekin „much“ — sanalamaydigan — „much money“ — pul; „many“ — sanaladigan — „many books“ — kitoblar.Nemis tili emas, lekin „a little“ — oz (ijobiy); „a few“ — oz (ijobiy).Nemis tili emas, lekin „little“ — oz (salbiy); „few“ — oz (salbiy) — „I have few friends“ — men do‘stlarim kam. Nemis tili emas, lekin eslab qoling: bitta inkor yetadi. Nemis tili emas, lekin „many / much“ ni ajratish — ingliz tilida zarur. Nemis tili emas, lekin mashq qiling.
scenes.say: I don't have any money. I don't see any problems. Much money, many books. A little money, a few books. Few friends — negative. Little time — negative. One negative is enough.
scenes.say_uz: Menda pul umuman yo‘q. Men umuman muammo ko‘rmayman. Pul ko‘p, kitoblar ko‘p. Ozgina pul, bir nechta kitob. Do‘stlarim kam. Vaqt kam. Bitta inkor yetadi.

scenes.title: Ikkita inkor mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta to‘g‘ri gap tuzing. Birinchi: „I don't have any money“ — bitta inkor. Ikkinchi: „much money“ (sanalamaydigan) va „many books“ (sanaladigan). Uchinchi: „I have few friends“ — kam — salbiy. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I don't have any money. How much money do you have? How many books do you have? I have few friends. I have a few friends. I have little time.
scenes.say_uz: Menda pul umuman yo‘q. Sizda qancha pul bor? Sizda nechta kitob bor? Men do‘stlarim kam. Men bir nechta do‘stlarga egman. Menda vaqt kam.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 8 ta xato gapni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Quyidagi 8 ta xato gapni tuzating: 1) I am doctor; 2) I have went; 3) She don't like; 4) I can to help; 5) He is agree; 6) Explain me; 7) on Monday in 5 pm; 8) I didn't finished. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Correct these eight sentences: I am doctor, I have went, She don't like, I can to help, He is agree, Explain me, on Monday in 5 pm, I didn't finished.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu sakkizta gapni tuzating: I am doctor, I have went, She don't like, I can to help, He is agree, Explain me, on Monday in 5 pm, I didn't finished.

scenes.title: Namuna: 8 ta tuzatish
scenes.say_native: Namuna tuzatish. „I am a doctor“. „I have gone“. „She doesn't like it“. „I can help you“. „I agree“. „Explain it to me“. „The meeting is on Monday at 5 pm“. „I didn't finish“. Nemis tili emas, lekin bu 8 xatoni takrorlab o‘rganish — 10 xatoni 1atadan 10atagacha kamaytiradi. Muntazam mashq qiling — har kuni ingliz tilida gapiring.
scenes.say: I am a doctor. I have gone. She doesn't like it. I can help you. I agree. Explain it to me. The meeting is on Monday at 5 pm. I didn't finish.
scenes.say_uz: Men shifokorman. Men bordim. U bekinchidan yoqtirmaydi. Men sizga yordam berishim mumkin. Men roziman. Menga tushuntiring. Yig‘ilish dushanba kuni soat beshda. Men tugatmadim.

scenes.title: Guruh 6: want / need / would like + infinitive

examples.t: She would like to come with us.

scenes.say_native: Want, need va would like har doim „to“ bilan bitta bilan keladi — oddiy fe’l bilan emas. „I want to learn English“ — men ingliz tilini o‘rganishni xohlayman — want + to + oddiy shakl. Nemis tili emas, lekin eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: „I want learn English“ — to yo‘q — noto‘g‘ri. Nemis tili emas, lekin „would like“ — xuddi shu — „I would like to order some tea“ — men choy buyurtma qilishni xohlayman — to order. „need“ — „You need to book the table in advance“ — siz stolni oldindan bron qilishingiz kerak — to book. Nemis tili emas, lekin uch so‘z: want, need, would like — uchtasi ham „to + oddiy shakl“. Nemis tili emas, lekin „I want to, I would like to, I need to“ — yod oling. Nemis tili emas, lekin mashq qiling — har kuni ingliz tilida gapiring.
scenes.say: I want to learn English. She would like to come with us. You need to book the table in advance. I want to, would like to, need to — always to. Never I want learn English.
scenes.say_uz: Men ingliz tilini o‘rganishni xohlayman. U biz bilan borishni xohlaydi. Siz stolni oldindan bron qilishingiz kerak. I want to, would like to, need to — har doim to. I want learn English hech qachon to‘g‘ri emas.

scenes.title: Infinitive mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta infinitive gapi yozing. Birinchi: „I want to learn English“ — want to. Ikkinchi: „She would like to come with us“ — would like to. Uchinchi: „You need to book the table in advance“ — need to. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I want to learn English. She would like to come with us. You need to book the table in advance. I want to go, I would like to stay, I need to finish.
scenes.say_uz: Men ingliz tilini o‘rganishni xohlayman. U biz bilan borishni xohlaydi. Siz stolni oldindan bron qilishingiz kerak. Men borishni xohlayman, qolishni xohlayman, tugatishim kerak.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashishuvchilarning eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xatosini tuzattirdik: artikllar (a/an/the), kelishuv (do/does), zamonlar (stative va tugallangan), predloglar (in/on/at), say/tell va soxta do‘stlar, ikkita inkor. Endi har kuni ingliz tilida xatosiz gapirasiz.
scenes.say: Today you fixed the 30 most common mistakes. Keep speaking English every day.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz eng ko‘p uchraydigan 30 xatoni tuzattingiz. Har kuni ingliz tilida gaplashib turing.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. 8 ta xato gapni o‘zingiz tuzing va to‘g‘ri shaklini yozing — artikl, kelishuv, zamon, predlog. Har kuni ingliz tilida 5 ta gap yozing. Keyingi darsda turizm va aeroport muammolarini o‘rganamiz. Auf Wiedersehen!
scenes.say: Fix eight mistakes at home and write five English sentences every day. See you in the next lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Uyda sakkizta xatoni tuzating va har kuni besh inglizcha gap yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishguncha.

homework_uz: 8 ta xato gapni tuzing va to‘g‘risini yozing: a doctor, have gone, doesn't like, can help, I agree, explain to me, at 5 pm, didn't finish. Har kuni ingliz tilida 5 ta gap yozing. Keyingi dars: Turizm muammolari.

quiz.why_uz: Birlik III shaxs — doesn't + base form.
